summary: Valneva SE filed a Form 6-K on June 4, 2026, announcing the availability of documentation for its Annual General Meeting to be held on June 25, 2026. The press release details the Preliminary Notice of Meeting, agenda, draft resolutions proposed by the Board of Directors, and instructions for participation and voting. This filing is a routine corporate governance notice and does not involve any special situation such as acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, or management changes. The registrant is a foreign private issuer reporting under Rule 13a-16 or 15d-16. No deal terms or financial metrics are stated.
